# fflate 0.8.3

Unmodified UMD distribution, used only for gzip engine decoding when DecompressionStream is unavailable. Official project: https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate . Downloaded 2026-10-04 from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fflate@0.8.3/umd/index.js . MIT license copied unchanged from the same package into FFLATE_LICENSE.txt. The Godot WASM bytes are unchanged; a second uncompressed copy is no longer needed in the Site archive.
